title: driver-memory: memory-readable-ids-conformance.test.ts's E3 pin 'a deleted parent is excluded' times out at vitest's 5000 ms default under CI load, reddening main's scheduled CI and ejecting PR #23674 from the merge queue
body:
Blocked-by: #23679

Filing gate **①**, a measured fleet-velocity cost (triage-duties' third tooling entry door). `reach:` **measured in CI, three times in about 90 minutes, on three different trees:**

| Run | Event | Tree | What failed |
|---|---|---|---|
| [38735497549](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/38735497549) | `pull_request` | PR #23674 at `82dae4a76e` | `Test Core (1/6)`: `packages/drivers/driver-memory` `pnpm run test exited (1)` (annotation; job log not readable from a seat container) |
| [38739484445](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/38739484445) | `schedule` | `main` at `8d1fb1fb2d` | `Test Core (4/6)`: the same driver-memory annotation |
| [38746430608](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/38746430608) | `merge_group` | PR #23674's queue build `329a4164f8` | `Test Core (1/6)`: **`src/memory-readable-ids-conformance.test.ts > [ADR-0139 D3] InMemoryDriver — ReadableIds conformance > E3 pins > a deleted parent is excluded, on find, count and aggregate alike`: `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.`** (the merge-queue-triage comment `6194362903` on PR #23674) |

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 2 (#22648) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01Q9PZ5Pzqcus4woVvTZwWNU`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

## What it costs

- PR #23674 (#23546, p1 `target:v18`) was ejected from the merge queue at 14:21Z. Every PR queued behind it was rebuilt.
- `main`'s scheduled CI at `8d1fb1fb2d` is red on the same package.
- The same package and tree were green elsewhere. PR #23674's merged head `6256d1f001` ran all six shards green, and a local run on that tree passed 71 files / 1732 tests (#23546's dev report). That is the shape of a load or timing cliff, not a deterministic break.

## Why, read (not measured)

- The pin was added by PR #23656 (`462dff36f1`, ADR-0139 E3 + E4, #23639), which landed at 11:42Z. The first red above is at 12:33Z.
- Its `beforeAll` seeds 2,700 parent rows and 2,700 child rows one `create` at a time (`BIG_READABLE = 2_400`, `BIG_UNREADABLE = 300`).
- The timed-out `it` then runs three full scans of the child table (`find`, `count`, `aggregate`) against a composed `ReadableIds` `$in` over the 2,400 readable parents, with no explicit timeout. That leaves vitest's 5,000 ms default.
- It is the heaviest of the four E3 pins (the other two scan once or twice).
- **NOT MEASURED:**
  - the pin's wall time on a quiet runner, versus a loaded one;
  - whether `InMemoryDriver`'s evaluation of a composed `$in` leaf is linear or quadratic in the candidate count. If it is quadratic, this is a product-performance finding, not only a test-budget one.

## Reader who acts

Triage grades it and routes it. The landing is `packages/drivers/driver-memory` (the ADR-0139 E3/E4 owner, #23639's lane, `domain:engine`). The decision is whether the cure is the pin's budget (a measured explicit timeout, or a smaller `BIG_READABLE` that still clears the 2,000-row window it guards) or the driver's evaluation of the leaf.

- ⛔ No test is skipped or quarantined by this card.
- #23546's PR is re-queued once by its seat, per the merge-queue-triage comment's own rule for a timeout.

**Dedupe words:** memory-readable-ids-conformance; ReadableIds E3 pins timeout; 'a deleted parent is excluded'; driver-memory Test timed out in 5000ms; BIG_READABLE.
